countries.reasoning: China is the largest producer of ceramics globally, accounting for around 70% of production based on recent industry and trade reports from 2023; high confidence due to multiple authoritative sources including Chinese government export data.

India holds the second position with substantial ceramic production driven by both industrial and artisanal output; data from Indian Ministry of Commerce and Industry 2023 reports, though less centralized than China.
The US maintains significant ceramic manufacturing capacity, especially in advanced ceramics; data from USGS and industry surveys 2022-2023 supports this figure with strong confidence.
Germany is a key European producer of industrial ceramics and traditional ceramic products; figures supported by Eurostat and German industrial associations, moderately high confidence.
Brazil is a notable ceramics producer in South America with growing production; data from Brazilian Mining and Industry reports 2022 with some uncertainties due to reporting completeness.
